qaris.name: Qārī Nazrul Islam
qaris.title: Ḥāfiẓ & Qārī
qaris.tagline: Dedicated to spreading the recitation of the Quran throughout the New York community
qaris.bio:
Qārī Nazrul Islam has been a pillar of Quranic education in the New York Muslim community for many years. He completed his hifz at a young age and went on to pursue formal training in the rules of Tajweed under senior scholars.

He is known for his warm teaching style and his dedication to students of all ages and backgrounds. His classes draw students from across the city who seek to improve their recitation and connection with the Quran.

Qārī Nazrul is actively involved in the local masjid community and regularly leads Taraweeh prayers during the blessed month of Ramadan.

Qārī Mujeeb Rahman is a distinguished Ḥāfiẓ and Tajweed scholar based in New York. He completed his Quranic memorization under the supervision of learned teachers and subsequently dedicated years to perfecting the science of Tajweed.

Known for his precise and melodious recitation, Qārī Mujeeb has taught numerous students in the New York area and helped many complete their journey to becoming Ḥuffāẓ. He is respected among his peers for his knowledge of the rules of recitation and his ability to identify and correct errors with kindness.

He is a frequent guest reciter at mosques and Islamic centers throughout New York and the surrounding tri-state area.

qaris.tagline: Combining Quranic memorization with broader Islamic education in New York
qaris.bio:
Qārī Abdullah Sikander is a Ḥāfiẓ of the Quran and Islamic studies teacher based in New York. He completed his hifz under the guidance of senior scholars and continued his education in Islamic sciences, developing a well-rounded foundation in both Quranic recitation and broader religious knowledge.

He teaches at local Islamic schools and runs Quran circles for students of all ages. His approach integrates Quranic memorization with understanding of the meanings and context of the verses being learned, making for a richer educational experience.

Qārī Abdullah is known in the community for his sincerity, his broad knowledge, and his commitment to the holistic Islamic education of the next generation.

Qārī Junayed Ahmed is a specialist in Quranic recitation with a deep passion for the art of Tajweed. He completed his memorization of the Holy Quran and went on to study the science of recitation in depth, mastering the rules that govern the proper pronunciation and flow of Quranic Arabic.

Based in New York, Qārī Junayed offers lessons to students at various levels, from those just beginning their journey with the Quran to experienced reciters seeking to refine their skills. He brings both knowledge and enthusiasm to every session.

He is a valued member of the New York Muslim community, regularly leading prayers and participating in Islamic educational events. His commitment to the Quran and to those who seek to learn it is a source of inspiration to all who know him.

qaris.name: Ḥāfiẓ Zaid Khan As-Salafi
qaris.title: Ḥāfiẓ & Qārī
qaris.tagline: Carrying forward the blessed chain of Quranic transmission in New York
qaris.bio:
Ḥāfiẓ Zaid Khan As-Salafi is a Ḥāfiẓ of the Holy Quran and a dedicated servant of the Quranic sciences. He received his Ijāzah in Ḥafs 'an 'Āṣim from Qārī Rayyin Ahsan, through whose blessed chain the sacred tradition of Quranic transmission continues.

His commitment to preserving and passing on the authentic recitation of the Quran reflects the noble legacy of the Salaf, and he strives to embody that tradition in both his personal practice and his teaching.
